title: Anthropic is Worth ~1 Trillion!
description:
Anthropic's revenue grew 5x in five months. That's the chart you're looking at.

The full trajectory: $9B in December, $14B in February, $30B in April, $47B in May. That growth rate is what justified today's $65B raise at a $965B valuation, led by Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia, with Amazon and Google as the hyperscaler anchors.

Infrastructure behind it: 5GW compute commitments from Amazon, 5GW next-gen TPU capacity from Google and Broadcom, GPU access in SpaceX's Colossus data centres. First frontier AI on all three major cloud platforms.

On Opus 4.8: effort control is now in the claude.ai UI (low, high, extra, max). Fast mode runs at 2.5x speed and is 3x cheaper than it was for Opus 4.7. Dynamic workflows are in research preview on Enterprise, Team, and Max Claude Code plans.

Mythos is currently deployed through Project Glasswing, Anthropic's defensive cybersecurity coalition, where it's been used to find zero-day vulnerabilities in major operating systems and browsers autonomously. Anthropic says cyber safeguards are the only thing holding back general release.

The fair counter argument: the IPO is coming, "too dangerous to release" is excellent pre-IPO positioning, and GPT-5.5 has reportedly closed a lot of the coding gap. Both things can be true at once.
